options: A type of dataset
A control activity for branching logic
A pipeline trigger type
The compute infrastructure that bridges an activity and a linked service
questions.explain: An activity defines the action, a linked service defines the target — the integration runtime is the actual compute that bridges the two and does the work.

questions.q: What are the three integration runtime types?
options: Source, Sink, and Transform
Azure, Self-hosted, and Azure-SSIS
Manual, Scheduled, and Event-based
Public, Private, and Hybrid
questions.explain: Azure IR handles cloud-to-cloud work, self-hosted IR bridges to on-premises data, and Azure-SSIS IR runs existing SSIS packages on a managed VM cluster.

questions.q: Can an integration runtime's location differ from the data factory's own region?
options: Yes — an IR's location is independent of where the data factory's metadata lives
Only Azure-SSIS IRs support a different region
No — an IR must always be in the same region as its data factory
Only self-hosted IRs can be in a different region
questions.explain: A data factory's metadata lives in one fixed region, but you can create an IR in a different region entirely — useful for keeping data movement inside a specific region for compliance.

questions.q: When both a self-hosted IR and an Azure IR could apply to an activity, which one takes precedence?
options: The self-hosted IR
Data Factory refuses to run the activity
The Azure IR always wins
Whichever was created first
questions.explain: Self-hosted IR takes precedence over an Azure IR in a managed virtual network, which in turn takes precedence over the global, autoresolve Azure IR.

questions.q: For a Copy activity, what happens if the source uses a self-hosted IR but the sink doesn't specify one?
options: The sink automatically uses the Azure IR instead
The copy activity fails immediately
The entire copy runs on the self-hosted IR — there's no mixing between source and sink runtimes
Data Factory picks whichever IR is geographically closer
questions.explain: If either the source or sink linked service points to a self-hosted IR, the whole Copy activity runs on that self-hosted IR.
